caption:
Against envy and magic, Allah taught us this

Al-Falaq teaches us to seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak from the harm of what He created, the darkness of night, those who blow on knots, and the envier. Make it part of your daily remembrance.

Surah Al-Falaq 113:1-5

Send this to someone who worries about envy

#surahfalaq #dailydhikr #protection #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
alt_text: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak; from the harm of all what He has created; from the harm of night’s darkness when it spreads around; from the harm of the sorceresses who blow on knots; and from the harm of the envier when he envies (Surah Al-Falaq 113:1-5)
